## Overview

This repository has **1 commit**, written by **Corpus fixture** (`fixture@example.invalid`). The current branch is `main`. The all-ref count and the `HEAD` count are the same: **1**.

## How It Works

`git rev-list --all --count` is **1**. `git rev-list HEAD --count` is **1**. `git status -sb` shows `## main`. The only ref is `refs/heads/main` at `d9722409cabd904e7339fda14fe1818d77be6641`.

That commit is a root commit (`Initial fixture`). Author and committer are both `Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>`.


With email: `1  Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>`. There is no `.mailmap` file and no `mailmap.file` or `mailmap.blob` config. `git log --all --use-mailmap` and `--no-use-mailmap` both print `Corpus fixture <fixture@example.invalid>`.

## Gotchas

Duplicate identities do not affect this count. There is one name and one email, and the author and committer are the same person. Mailmap has no mapping to apply, so it does not merge or split anyone.

Merges do not affect it either. `git rev-list --all --merges --count` is **0**, and `--no-merges` is **1**. The only commit has no parents, so the all-ref total is not inflated by merge commits, and the author tally is one commit from one person.
